messages:
ana_marketing: Hey folks — prep ask for next Friday's webinar + social push. Need a benchmark asset bundle: 4 social tiles (square), 2 widescreen slides for the deck, and an editable one-sheet. Main theme: inference economics — prioritise clear visuals for latency vs $/token. Also want a small legal-friendly footnote for Dedicated customers. Deadline: Thurs EOD for internal QA.

leo_design: Cool. Prefer to design in vector so translations are clean. Which sizes exactly? And should the social tiles be a set or variant A/B?

ana_marketing: Set of 4 that can be mixed for A/B: stat, micro-chart, feature-callout, and customer quote. Sizes: 1080x1080 for socials, 1200x628 for FB link preview, 1920x1080 for slide. One-sheet: US Letter, layered PDF and Figma.

leo_design: Got it. Propose illustration style: simplified grids with a single accent color + neutral background. Want to avoid heavy screenshots. Accent hex: #00A3FF? Is that approved?

tara_content: Use voice: concise, outcome-first. Example headline: "Lower inference cost, keep tail latency tight." Microcopy examples: "1. Predictable p95 latency" "2. 2–3x cost reduction on cacheable workloads" "3. Fast rollouts with A/B failover" CTA: "Register for benchmark webinar".

devon_growth: Add UTM string for all CTA links: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=inference_launch&utm_medium=social_asset. Also request a lightweight animated GIF 4 slides -> 10s for LinkedIn.

sam_ops: Compliance note: For Dedicated callout include small footer: "Dedicated deployments available with contractual SLAs and export controls". Make sure the footer is readable at 8pt. Also flag any customer quote needs permission; if we use anon quote, mark as (customer, industry).

leo_design: Plan: 4 art comps (A/B color variants), will supply SVGs, layered Figma file, PNG exports, GIF, MP4 1080x1080 10s. Export guidelines will be included in Figma file. Example export block:
```
Exports:
- SVG (optimized)
- PNG 1080x1080 (sRGB) social
- PNG 1200x628 (72dpi) link preview
- PNG 1920x1080 webinar hero
- MP4 1080x1080 10s @30fps H.264 baseline
- PDF US Letter (editable layers) + print-ready PDF
- Figma: /Marketing/Assets/Inference-Econ-May
```

tara_content: Copy for stat tile: "Up to 3x reduction in per-token spend on caching-friendly prompts." Chart caption: "Benchmarks run on 8k context across conversational and summarize workloads." Quote placeholder: "\"Switched to Redwood and cut inference spend 40%\" — (Customer, Enterprise SaaS)"

devon_growth: Also request alt text for each social tile for accessibility and a plain-text one-pager for press. We'll need localized versions in FR and DE if possible; mark as stretch goal but prepare copy placeholders in English.

leo_design: Will include alt-text fields in Figma and a copy page with FR/DE placeholders. Can we push the final deliverables by Thu 17:00 PT?

ana_marketing: Yes, Thu 17:00 PT works. I'll run a quick internal QA pass then route to legal + security for the footer review. :white_check_mark:

assetbot: Reminder: upload final Figma and export zip to /assets/marketing/inference-econ-may/ by 2026-05-15T00:00:00Z for compliance review.

sam_ops: One more ask: include a tiny flow diagram (simple 3-step) showing Request -> Cache/Batching -> Serve (Hosted/Dedicated) to visually explain how cost savings happen. Keep it icon-based and color-blind friendly.

leo_design: Noted. I'll add the 3-step flow as an extra slide. Ping me for copy tweaks once the prototype is up.

ana_marketing: Thanks all — ping me in this thread when mocks are in Figma. I'll collect feedback and assemble the webinar registration page assets. :rocket:
